meta.name: codeman
meta.description: Drive Codeman, the session manager this agent is running inside, over its HTTP API: list sessions, start worker sessions, send them prompts, block until they finish (wait / wait-output / send-and-wait), read their output, and clean up; where available, message claude workers directly (Claude Code cross-session messaging). Use when asked to orchestrate or parallelize work across Codeman sessions, watch another session, or start and manage workers. Only usable inside a Codeman-managed session (CODEMAN_MUX=1); refuse to act otherwise.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行调度多个编码会话,派任务、等它们跑完、读结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头多个编码任务要同时推进,又不想逐个盯着等结果
copy.tagline_en: Dispatch and run several coding sessions in parallel, then collect their results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several coding tasks at once and don't want to babysit each one

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Codeman 的 HTTP API 管理本机上的其他会话：列出会话、启动 worker 会话、给它们发提示、阻塞等待其结束、读取输出并清理。
howto.when: 只在 Codeman 管理的会话内可用（CODEMAN_MUX=1），否则直接拒绝执行；当你要求跨会话并行编排、监视另一会话，或启动并管理 worker 时触发。

say.text: 启动两个 worker 会话分别做这两件事，完成后把输出给我
say.note: 它会新建会话、派活并等待结果

say.text: 看看我另一个会话现在跑到哪了，把它最新的输出读出来
say.note: 读取目标会话的终端输出

say.text: 这个 worker 用完就删掉
say.note: 带自身会话保护地删除会话

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive Codeman's HTTP API from inside its session: list sessions, start worker sessions, send them prompts, block until they finish, read their output, and clean up.
howto.when_en: Only works inside a Codeman-managed session (CODEMAN_MUX=1); otherwise it refuses. Triggers when asked to parallelize work across sessions, watch another session, or start and manage workers.

say_en.text: Start two worker sessions for these two tasks and give me their output when done
say_en.note: It creates the sessions, tasks them and waits

say_en.text: Check where my other session is now and read its latest output
say_en.note: Reads the target session's terminal output

say_en.text: Delete that worker session once it's done
